bias.en: Neutral · on the 30 and 100-day averages before results
bias.zh: 中性 · 业绩前站在 30 日与 100 日均线上

read.en: ASML eased 1.7% on Oct 12 to $1,750, closing at the day's low and 6% below its Oct 5 close. It is under its 5 and 10-day averages ($1,788–1,812) but sitting right on the 30-day ($1,731) and 100-day ($1,746), with the 200-day ($1,565) rising. MACD crossed below its signal on Oct 12, RSI is 49, and Parabolic SAR is still bullish but only 1.5% below price ($1,725).
read.zh: 阿斯麦 10月12日下跌 1.7%，收于 $1,750，收在当日最低，较 10月5日收盘价下跌 6%。股价位于 5 日和 10 日均线（$1,788–1,812）下方，但正站在 30 日（$1,731）和 100 日（$1,746）均线上，200 日均线（$1,565）向上。MACD 于 10月12日下穿信号线，RSI 为 49，抛物线 SAR 仍看多，但仅在股价下方 1.5%（$1,725）。

read.en: The $1,725–1,746 band (30 and 100-day averages plus SAR) decides the short-term trend going into results; a close below it points to $1,619 (Sep 3 low), then $1,573. Resistance is the 5 and 10-day averages at $1,788–1,812, then the Oct 2 high of $1,873.50 and the $2,000 record.
read.zh: $1,725–1,746 区间（30 日、100 日均线及 SAR）决定业绩前的短线走势；若收盘跌破，下看 $1,619（9月3日低点），再看 $1,573。阻力为 $1,788–1,812 的 5 日和 10 日均线，其次 10月2日高点 $1,873.50 及 $2,000 纪录高点。
